treatment: candidate_diagnostics records executed candidate Python calls, handled exceptions with propagated library traceback locations, and limited scalar returns in a separate instrumented run. It does not compare intermediate tensors, measure per-site numerical errors, or locate the first numerical divergence. Those observations remain unavailable unless another actual collector supplies them.
